title: Promoting gambling in the second degree.
bodyText:
(1) A person commits the offense of promoting gambling in the second degree if the person negligently advances or profits from gambling activity.

(2) Promoting gambling in the second degree is a class C felony.
bodyHtml:
§712-1222  Promoting gambling in the second degree.  (1)  A person commits the offense of promoting gambling in the second degree if the person negligently advances or profits from gambling activity.

     (2)  Promoting gambling in the second degree is a class C felony. [L 1972, c 9, pt of §1; am L 1973, c 201, pt of §1; am L 1987, c 83, §2; gen ch 1992; am L 2022, c 111, §5]
